seoTitle: Clément DOUIN | Rust and PIM engineer
seoDesc: Independent engineer, creator of Himalaya and Pimalaya. I build and maintain email, contacts and calendar integrations in Rust.
eyebrow: Independent engineer · Rust · Email, contacts, calendars
title: Software that talks to mail servers, and keeps talking.
lead: I build and maintain email, contacts and calendar integrations in Rust: IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV, OAuth and offline sync. The creator of Himalaya and the Pimalaya project, since 2022.

services.title: PIM integration
services.text: Mail, contacts and calendars in your product, across Gmail, Microsoft 365 and standard servers. Sign-in, discovery, sync, the provider quirks already handled.

services.title: Rust engineering
services.text: Libraries, CLIs and services designed to last: I/O-free cores, clear boundaries, tests against real systems. Audits and rescue of existing Rust code too.

services.title: Maintenance
services.text: Providers change their rules every year. I keep integrations working through protocol changes, OAuth renewals and platform updates.

servicesNote: Beyond PIM: ten years of TypeScript, React and Node before Rust. Ask if your project sits elsewhere.
workTitle: Pimalaya, and what is built on it
workLead: Most of my time since 2022 goes into Pimalaya: open-source Rust tools for personal information, written from the RFCs up and tested against the providers people use.

work.name: Pimalaya libraries
work.text: IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV, OAuth and discovery, as I/O-free libraries any runtime can drive.

work.name: Himalaya
work.text: The email client for the terminal that started it all, scriptable through its JSON output.

work.name: Pimalaya for Android
work.text: Mail, contacts and calendars in one offline-first app, on the same libraries.

work.name: With Red Arrow
work.text: A desktop client for mail, contacts and calendars built on the Pimalaya stack, as its first partner.

consultingText: An integration to build, code to audit, a team to unblock. Remote, from France, in English or French.
partnershipText: Your product or your servers on the Pimalaya stack, tested on every release and maintained year after year.
contactTitle: Tell me what you need to connect
contactLead: A short call first, then a written proposal with a fixed scope.
